cases.name: lineread-eof-no-newline
cases.expr: (let S (open "programs/eof-lineread.txt" in) L1 (lineread S) L2 (lineread S) (do (close S) [L1 L2]))
cases.doc: 42.1 reader fix: lineread returns the final line of a stream that ends at EOF WITHOUT a trailing newline (programs/eof-lineread.txt has none). Driven through a file stream, not REPL stdin: upstream shen-scheme 0.50's REPL loops at stdin EOF, so a stdin probe would test the REPL rather than the reader.

cases.name: read-eof-no-newline
cases.expr: (let S (open "programs/eof-read.txt" in) A (read S) B (read S) (do (close S) [A B]))
cases.doc: 42.1 reader fix: read returns a final token that is terminated only by EOF (programs/eof-read.txt is `(+ 40 2) 42` with no trailing newline), so the bare 42 is not lost or left waiting for more input. File stream, not REPL stdin (see lineread-eof-no-newline).

cases.name: source-form-before-macros
cases.doc: 42.1 source-form handlers run BEFORE ordinary macros, and macros still expand what a handler produces. bifrost-probe has both a handler (-> bifrost-probe2) and a macro rule (-> macro-first); the forms come from read-from-string after registration (a script is read whole before it runs, so the handler cannot apply to its own file). A port that does not boot shen.register-source-form prints the BIFROST-SKIP capability marker (capability SKIP).

cases.name: namespace-externals-expression
cases.doc: 42.2 namespaces: (externals EXPR) EVALUATES EXPR to a symbol list (here a call, (bifrost-ns-vocab)); 42.1 took only a literal list. bifrost-ns-ext stays global and local becomes bifrost.demo.local. Only ports that boot the experimental extension-namespaces.kl run it (shen-scheme, shen-rust at the time of writing); ports where (shen.x.namespaces.initialise) is unavailable print the BIFROST-SKIP capability marker (capability SKIP).
